name: climate-intelligence
description: Environmental and climate data tool. Provides real-time and historical carbon emissions data, climate risk assessments, ESG metrics and sustainability benchmarks. Integrates data from INPE, IPCC reports and global climate databases.

tools.name: get_emissions_data
tools.description: Returns carbon emissions data for a country, sector or company over a specified period. Includes CO2, methane and N2O in CO2-equivalent tons.

tools.name: assess_climate_risk
tools.description: Evaluates physical and transition climate risks for a geographic region or industry sector. Returns risk score, exposure level and recommended adaptation measures.

tools.name: get_esg_benchmark
tools.description: Returns ESG performance benchmarks for an industry sector or company ticker. Includes environmental score, social score, governance score and composite rating.
